content: Klaviyo segmentation: dynamic segments combine profile properties, behavioral/event data, and custom properties; built-in RFM (Recency/Frequency/Monetary) 1-5 scoring auto-classifies customers into named groups; AI-driven predictive analytics (churn risk, CLV, predicted next order date) usable as segment conditions; natural-language 'Segments AI' generates segment definitions; segments update in real time.
